name: National Policy on Skill Development, 2009
change: Established a national framework to develop employable skills among youth through vocational training, industry partnerships, and expansion of skill institutions.
impact: Laid the foundation for structured skill development in India, though implementation initially remained limited in scale. :contentReference[oaicite:0]{index=0}

name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA), 2005
change: Provides a legal guarantee of 100 days of wage employment to rural households for unskilled work.
impact: Acts as a safety net for rural employment and reduces poverty, but does not directly address long-term skill development.

name: Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY), 2014
change: Provides skill training and placement support to rural youth, especially from poor households, with focus on industry-relevant skills.
impact: Improves employability of rural youth, though placement quality and sustainability remain concerns. :contentReference[oaicite:1]{index=1}

name: Skill India Mission, 2015
change: A comprehensive initiative to provide large-scale skill training through programs like PMKVY, apprenticeships, and ITIs aligned with industry needs.
impact: Expanded access to skill training and improved employability, though skill-job mismatch remains a challenge. :contentReference[oaicite:2]{index=2}

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY), 2015
change: Provides short-term training, certification, and financial rewards for skill development in various sectors.
impact: Increases skill certification and training reach, but placement outcomes are inconsistent. :contentReference[oaicite:3]{index=3}

name: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS), 2016
change: Encourages employers to provide on-the-job training through financial incentives and simplified apprenticeship regulations.
impact: Promotes industry-linked training and practical skills, improving job readiness.

name: SANKALP Scheme, 2018
change: Focuses on strengthening institutional mechanisms for skill development and improving quality of training programs.
impact: Improves governance of skill programs and alignment with industry requirements. :contentReference[oaicite:4]{index=4}

name: Jan Shikshan Sansthan (JSS) Scheme Expansion, 2018
change: Provides vocational training to non-literate and school dropout adults, especially in rural areas.
impact: Enhances livelihood opportunities for marginalized groups and promotes inclusive skill development. :contentReference[oaicite:5]{index=5}

name: Skill India Programme Restructuring, 2022
change: Merged major skill schemes like PMKVY, NAPS, and JSS into a unified program to create a demand-driven, technology-enabled training system.
impact: Improves coordination and efficiency in skill development initiatives and promotes a future-ready workforce. :contentReference[oaicite:6]{index=6}

name: Employment Linked Incentive Scheme, 2025
change: Provides financial incentives to employers and first-time employees to encourage job creation and workforce participation.
impact: Supports employment generation and reduces entry barriers for new workers, though long-term sustainability depends on economic growth. :contentReference[oaicite:7]{index=7}
